contract: construct() -> 168 residues, one for each prime p <= 1000 in increasing order, with 0 <= r_p < p. The score is the largest L such that every integer 1..L satisfies at least two of the congruences x = r_p (mod p) (exact count, capped at 10^5). Maximize; L >= 1000 would realize the property asked in Erdős Problem #689 at n = 1000.
notes: Scores are doubly covered lengths for n = 1000; reaching 1000 would exhibit the property at this size. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs; the Mahler measure and reciprocal sums are reported as floats. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.
